commit.message: feat(safety): add default-off Darwin vh pre-apply observer

interface_mismatches: Darwin apply_diff_and_test currently constructs DiffApplier and mutates before pytest. DiffApplier.apply_and_test deletes rollback backups after a passing test, so a post-test observer cannot reliably undo the change.
Darwin evaluate() copies caller results then always sets status to EVALUATED, which would erase a pre-apply REJECTED observer block unless that path is preserved.
Sandbox result parsing prefers pytest counts found in stdout over the process exit code, so a synthetic observer-block result must keep stdout empty.
honest_blockers: demo calibrates selected-engine liveness only and does not inspect or verify a proposal diff.
The child receives a scrubbed environment and empty working directory. That is not a security sandbox, and PATH-selected binaries are not authenticated.
Binary SHA-256 is diagnostic identity only. Fake binaries prove wiring and policy behavior only.
This is not a compiler, formal verifier, proof system, or dual-process compiler.
Default mode is off. Required Python CI does not depend on Rust. A skipped live vh test is not live verification evidence.
Python represents a child-reported CLEAN result but must not infer CLEAN from missing, malformed, or exit-code-only evidence.
Pairwise replay agreement is sampled evidence, not a determinism proof.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the commits on cursor/vh-darwin-observer-9008. Darwin apply paths resume without a pre-apply observer, and default-off behavior remains the conservative no-lookup path.
